# Ranching Ranching in trauma station is a near copy of the ranching for goon-station most things from that wiki are applicable to trauma (https://wiki.ss13.co/Rancher)
# Getting Started You start your ranching journey buy hatching a white chicken egg that you have been supplied with in your ranching locker, in the incubator which should be on your farm.
# Unlocking every chickens To unlock every chicken in the game you can follow this guide, most chickens are unlocked by simplify feeding the previous chicken something but others are more complex.
# Needs of your chickens Chickens need to be fed and petted every so often, don't hurt them or the roosters will attack you, don't overcrowd them, or they'll become upset and don't feed them chicken nuggets!
# Eggs Most chicken eggs have a special effect when you eat them, the best way to find out is to just eat one and see!
